enchantment.arcaneforge.apocalyptic_judg: Hitting with a bow or crossbow calls down lightning and a small explosion on the target. The weapon never loses durability.
enchantment.arcaneforge.arcane_cataclysm: Hitting with a mace launches nearby enemies into the air, greatly boosts the hit's damage and triggers a small explosion.
enchantment.arcaneforge.arcane_repulse.d: Blocking with the shield pushes nearby enemies away, reflects part of the damage and reduces the damage you take.
enchantment.arcaneforge.chain_thunder.de: Hitting with the trident calls down lightning that also jumps to nearby enemies.
enchantment.arcaneforge.eternal_feast.de: While carrying this food, your hunger never drops and you occasionally get beneficial effects.
enchantment.arcaneforge.ethereal_hook.de: Fishing has a chance to also give you extra valuable items on top of the normal catch.
The trident flies much faster and farther when thrown.
enchantment.arcaneforge.ethereal_walk.de: With chestplate and boots on, running and jumping creates invisible platforms under your feet to cross the void.
enchantment.arcaneforge.soul_delve.desc: Mining grants extra experience per block and has a chance to duplicate one of the drops.
enchantment.arcaneforge.soul_harvest.des: With a hoe: auto-harvests and replants mature crops around you, and hitting mobs has a chance to steal experience.
Turns a Totem of Undying into one with 3 charges: a lethal hit saves you, heals you and knocks nearby enemies back.
enchantment.arcaneforge.void_wings.desc: With an elytra equipped, you take no fall damage and glide faster; at high level the elytra never loses durability.
Mining raw iron, gold or copper turns it straight into ingots without needing a furnace.
enchantment.arcaneforge.arcane_mending.d: Automatically repairs your damaged gear by spending your own stored experience.
enchantment.arcaneforge.dimensional_bind: Turns a bundle into a bag with near-infinite space to stack huge amounts of a single item.
enchantment.arcaneforge.arcane_magnet.de: Automatically sends what you mine and what mobs drop straight into your dimensional bag, no picking up needed.
enchantment.arcaneforge.arcane_loyalty.d: The enchanted item never drops on death; you get it back intact when you respawn.
enchantment.arcaneforge.miners_sight.des: With the helmet on, highlights nearby ores through walls, at the cost of experience.
enchantment.arcaneforge.night_vision.des: While wearing the helmet, you see in the dark permanently.
The bucket never empties when used, and never gets consumed as furnace fuel.
enchantment.arcaneforge.cadena_arcana.de: On hit, part of the damage also jumps to other nearby enemies.
Chance to hit while ignoring part of the enemy's armor.
enchantment.arcaneforge.golpe_dimensiona: Chance to teleport right behind the enemy when you hit them.
enchantment.arcaneforge.filo_eterno.desc: Consecutive hits on the same enemy deal more and more damage, as long as you don't wait too long between them.
enchantment.arcaneforge.marca_del_cazado: Chance to mark a hit enemy: while marked, it takes extra damage from any attack.
enchantment.arcaneforge.golpe_sismico.de: Chance to create a shockwave that pushes and slows enemies around the target you hit.
enchantment.arcaneforge.sangria_espectra: Chance to inflict a bleed (Wither) that gets worse the more often you hit.
The lower the enemy's remaining health, the more bonus damage you deal.
enchantment.arcaneforge.golpe_partidor.d: Axe. Chance to break the enemy's shield block and briefly stun them (Slowness + Mining Fatigue). Higher level means more chance and longer stun.
enchantment.arcaneforge.floracion_fertil: Hoe. Chance that a harvested mature crop instantly regrows on the spot, skipping its growth stages.
enchantment.arcaneforge.zancada_fantasma: Leggings. Never trigger pressure plates or tripwires, your footsteps make no sound and leave no vibration for sculk sensors, and your player name tag stays hidden from others.
enchantment.arcaneforge.carga_instantane: Crossbow. Draws dramatically faster; at high level it loads almost instantly.
You don't lose experience on death: you respawn with the same level you had.
enchantment.arcaneforge.coraza_arcana.de: Reduces all damage you take, including damage that normally bypasses armor.
enchantment.arcaneforge.vampiro.desc: Hitting steals part of the damage as your own health; at full health, that healing becomes temporary bonus hearts.
enchantment.arcaneforge.paso_nevado.desc: With boots on, you walk on powder snow without sinking.
enchantment.arcaneforge.paso_infernal.de: With boots on, you walk on lava without sinking and are immune to fire and lava damage.
enchantment.arcaneforge.paso_acuatico.de: With this saddle equipped, your mount (horse, pig or llama) walks on top of water without sinking.
enchantment.arcaneforge.ataque_veloz.des: Increases the weapon's attack speed, letting you hit faster at full damage.
enchantment.arcaneforge.almacen_infinito: The enchanted chest stores huge amounts of a single item per slot, far beyond the normal limit.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: You mine at normal speed while underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Deals much more damage to spiders, cave spiders, endermites and silverfish.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: You can't normally remove this armor piece; it stays on until it breaks.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Ignores part of the enemy's armor (less effective against fully armored players).
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Hitting with the trident during a thunderstorm calls down lightning on the target.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: With the mace, the farther you fall before hitting, the more bonus damage you deal.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Sets the target on fire when you hit it.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows shot from this bow catch fire on impact.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Mining has a chance to yield more items than usual.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Turns water under your feet into ice as you walk.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Deals more damage to aquatic creatures.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting this bow doesn't consume arrows from your inventory.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Pushes the hit enemy back much farther.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Mobs drop more items when killed by your hit.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: The trident returns to your hand after being thrown.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Improves the odds of fishing up rare, valuable items.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: With the spear, a solid hit lets you lunge forward, costing some hunger.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Automatically repairs the item using the experience you collect.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: The crossbow fires 3 arrows at once using just one.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Crossbow bolts pierce through multiple enemies in a row.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Increases the damage of arrows shot from this bow.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Pushes the enemy hit by an arrow much farther back.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: You can hold your breath longer underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident while in rain or water launches you along with it.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Mines blocks as themselves instead of their usual drops (e.g. ore block instead of raw material).
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Deals much more damage to zombies, skeletons and other undead.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: You move faster over soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: The sword's sweep attack deals more damage.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Chance to reflect part of the damage back at whoever hits you.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: The item has a better chance to not lose durability when used.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item disappears instead of dropping on the ground if you die.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: With the mace, the hit creates a gust of wind that launches you upward.
advancements.arcaneforge.root.title: A Whisper of Arcana
advancements.arcaneforge.get_wand.title: Key to Every Chest
advancements.arcaneforge.enchant_level_1: Have an item with an arcane enchantment at level 100 or higher
advancements.arcaneforge.enchant_level_m: Reach the true max level, 255, on an arcane enchantment
Place a chest with Infinite Storage
